subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS phone proxy

question: Is same-package/signature Wear Data Layer pairing an acceptable authorization boundary for exposing session history, send, and abort operations without an additional in-app watch approval step?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately credential-free and method-bounded, but choosing whether platform pairing alone authorizes chat control is a product-security decision that tests and static review cannot settle.

options.title: Accept platform pairing
options.body: Treat Google's same-application Data Layer boundary as sufficient after paired-device proof confirms the documented behavior.

options.title: Add phone approval
options.body: Require an explicit phone-side approval and revocation record before a watch node may call history, send, or abort operations.

options.title: Limit the first stage
options.body: Ship status and session discovery first, deferring transcript and mutation operations until the watch authorization model is finalized.

recommendation.title: Accept platform pairing
recommendation.body: Treat Google's same-application Data Layer boundary as sufficient after paired-device proof confirms the documented behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked architecture and PR establish this security/product boundary, and prior Android history connects this person to the area beyond merely proposing this branch.
